title: Ryder's Cove Retreat | KEY.co
description_expanded: With four inviting bedrooms, this home accommodates up to 11 guests, making it perfect for families and friends seeking a tranquil getaway. The main level boasts a luxurious primary bedroom with a king-sized bed and a private full bath, while an additional bedroom on the same level features two twin beds. Ascend to the loft space to discover a cozy double bed with its own private bath. Upstairs, a king-sized bedroom with a private bath and a charming work station awaits, complete with a window seat overlooking the captivating cove. The lower level offers a haven for the younger guests with two sets of bunk beds and a private bath, comfortably accommodating four. Step outside onto the new deck, where you'll find an expansive outdoor living area, perfect for gatherings and relaxation. Fire up the gas grill for a memorable cookout, rinse off in the outdoor shower after a day at the beach, and unwind on the plush lounge furniture. Ryder's Cove is just a stone's throw away, offering opportunities for charter fishing and kayaking, with kayaks provided for your convenience. This idyllic retreat is conveniently located, with Chatham's center and several pristine beaches only a short distance away. Whether you're seeking summer adventures or off-season serenity, this home is your key to a truly unforgettable escape.
